description: Writes the high byte of the input into the record, derives a table-based step and a remaining count, optionally adjusts the count using two bit tests, fills a run of bytes and stores the status and flag words.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:9:5CA4

description: Applies bit-test adjustments to a remaining count, fills a run of bytes from a table value, derives a capped table-based step, and stores the resulting count and flag word into the record.

name: compute_nibble_bounds_and_spans
